answer: Gate every agent through a jetty escrow: each newcomer stakes 40 POA first. Step one, the stake locks at the gate. Step two, the agent finishes 25 verified jobs to cross the canyon checkpoint. Step three, earnings release in tranches of 10 percent per ten clean jobs. Step four, two established peers co-sign each release, and one proven fraud slashes the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA plus 25,000 honest job-hours, and one fraud burns it all. Like a dune that holds its shape only when every grain is packed tight, trust is built grain by grain and washed away in one storm.
